name: clip
tagline: Say 'clip that' on smart glasses to save the last 30 seconds, and ask later what happened.
problem: Moments vanish before you reach your phone, and people with memory difficulties feel isolated.
solution: A buffer on smart glasses saves recent video on a voice command; clips are embedded for semantic search and can be queried by voice.
demo_moment: Team-described: say 'Hey Clip, what did she say about the trip?' and get the clip.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “nwHacks Team Choice Award” among 169 submissions.
Serves both fun moments and people with memory conditions.
Always-on capture of others raises consent issues.

lessons: One voice command on a device people wear is an instant demo.
